predicates_and_outcomes: Help attempts to stabilize an applicable creature at 0 HP with successful DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine); no proficiency prerequisite printed.

Unconscious: Incapacitated and Prone, drops held things, Speed 0 cannot increase, unaware; ending Unconscious leaves Prone. Incoming attacks have Advantage, successful incoming hits within 5 feet are Critical Hits, Strength/Dexterity saves automatically fail; none grants the familiar an attack.

Knockout first aid is an action and successful DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine), ending that knockout Unconscious state; HP regain also ends that state. This is not generic healing or a cure for all causes of Unconscious.
Knockout source creation is melee-attack-triggered and NOT granted to a familiar; the aid branch may assist a creature knocked out by another actor.

Ordinary monsters die at 0 HP unless GM uses character treatment; apply stabilization only to an actual eligible surviving target. Familiar itself disappears at 0 HP, overriding remaining-on-scene stabilization.
